comparison.objective: Carry an open tray of loose parts with both arms while keeping it level.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load transport, continuous orientation control, and spill avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Tray tilt remains within 15 degrees; setup, travel endpoint, spill rubric, and scoring are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests coordinated transport and levelness rather than tool-on-insert alignment, hammer impulse regulation, fracture, and individual fragment recovery.
